verses.1: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.
verses.2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.
verses.3: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.4: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
